summary: At night Paris comes to the Capulet tomb to strew flowers for Juliet and has his Page keep watch
Romeo arrives with Balthasar, gives him a letter for his father and sends him away under threat; Balthasar hides nearby
Romeo breaks open the tomb; Paris thinks he has come to dishonour the dead and tries to arrest him
They fight, the Page runs to call the watch, and Paris dies asking to be laid with Juliet; Romeo then recognises him as Mercutio's kinsman
